page.overview:
Who is Farok's son?

Farok's son was a young Fremen who had been a Jihadi Soldier during the Naraj campaign where he was blinded during the Battle of Naraj by a Stone burner attack.

Unable to find a suitable wife, as his father had neglected the Fremen tradition to expel his disabled son into the deep Desert, his son befriended Lichna, daughter of Otheym and made her a Semuta addict to attach her to himself.

Farok's son was murdered along with Lichna and his father by Scytale when the Face Dancer adapted Lichna's identity.
